answer: Require each new identity to burn 9 tokens before earning: the burn is a one-way bridge with no refund, so money spent on fakes never returns. Rewards per identity cap at 7 tokens, vested over 14 epochs, and each must pass three random spot checks in its first nine epochs; missing one voids all unvested tokens. Scale only deepens the loss: one sybil loses at least 2 tokens, ten lose 20, and a nebula of a thousand fakes loses 2,000, because the cap bars extra identities from breaking even. The registry keeps an atlas of burn receipts and signed check responses for any auditor to replay.
